svg.metadata: Original scientific diagrams and electron-pair arrows: 祭音Myyura
svg.text: 2022 I-1: electron-pair mechanisms and chair conformation
Resonance contributors of the intermediate (the tetrahedral C bears Cl and OH):
The more stable secondary cation gives isopropylbenzene preferentially.
OH and Me: same face; i-Pr: opposite face. All three C–substituent bonds are equatorial.
Blue curved arrows represent electron pairs. Me = CH₃; i-Pr = CH(CH₃)₂.
